title: automation: a connector_action node sends input keys its action does not declare to the provider (open input schemas, no refusal)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #33346 row 254 (PR #33547; os-dev-report 6886439582, `out_of_scope_findings[2]`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade. #33346 was re-graded p2 on this row (6885601326) because stale inputs reached the provider.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open connector undeclared input` and `is:issue is:open judgeConnectorInput` find only #33346.

## What happens

A `connector_action` flow node whose `connectorConfig.input` holds keys the chosen action does not declare sends them to the provider at run time. PR #33547 stops the Studio designer from saving such keys on a connector/action switch; flows already saved with stale keys, and flows written by any other path (API, package import, AI authoring), still send them.

## Why (read on `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4` by the #33346 dev)

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/connector-nodes.ts` ~L139 `resolveValueSlotMap(cfg.input)` hands the whole map to the handler.
- `judgeConnectorInput` refuses only schema violations, and every shipped connector input schema is open (no `additionalProperties: false`), so undeclared keys pass.

## Acceptance (for the owning lane to decide the shape)

- An input key the action does not declare is refused loudly (at publish, or at run), or dropped with a recorded warning — not silently sent. Contract-first is the default (publish-time refusal).
